(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A system for generating a counter-stimulation in a patient suffering from RLS, the system comprising: a device configured and arranged to generate a counter-stimulation in a patient suffering from RLS, the counter-stimulation of an amplitude, intensity, and time duration __not less than that which would wake the patient and not more than that sufficient to relieve RLS symptoms, or sufficient to relieve RLS symptoms without waking the patient__; a controller configured and arranged to drive the counter-stimulation generation device, the controller in communication with the counter-stimulation device; and a base configured and arranged to hold the counter-stimulation generation device adjacent to a patient, the counter-stimulation device attached to the base.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The system according to Claim 1, wherein the device comprises a stimulator selected from the group consisting of a fluid pressure applicator, a mechanical point pressure applicator, a mechanical roller, a mechanical lift, a vibration generator, a nerve stimulator, a muscle stimulator, a heater, a cooler, a chemical applicator, and a magnet that does not solely comprise a fluid pressure applicator.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: A method of treating RLS, the method comprising: selecting a patient experiencing RLS; stimulating a portion of the patient at an amplitude, intensity, and duration sufficient to act as a counter-stimulation to RLS and __not waking the patient while allowing the patient to return to sleep__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 16: The method according to Claim 15, wherein said patient is asleep; and wherein said counter-stimulation is insufficient to wake the patient.

(Currently Amended) Claim 18: The method according to Claim 15, wherein said counter-stimulation is selected from the group consisting of pressure application, mechanical point pressure application, a mechanically rolling against the patient's skin, mechanically lifting at least a portion of the patient, vibration, a nerve stimulation, a muscle stimulation, heat, cold, a chemical application, and magnetism, __wherein the pressure application is not the sole mode of counter-stimulation__.
